Copy selector：
#app > div > div.form-box

2. 用户名输入框
outerHTML：<input type="text" autocomplete="off" maxlength="20" placeholder="请输入账号" class="el-input__inner">
Copy selector：#app > div > div.form-box > form > div:nth-child(1) > div > div.el-input.el-input--small.el-input--prefix > input

3. 密码输入框
outerHTML：<input type="password" autocomplete="off" maxlength="24" placeholder="请输入密码" class="el-input__inner">
Copy selector：#app > div > div.form-box > form > div:nth-child(2) > div > div.el-input.el-input--small.el-input--prefix.el-input--suffix > input

4.验证码输入框
<input type="text" autocomplete="off" maxlength="4" placeholder="请输入图形验证码" class="el-input__inner">
#app > div > div.form-box > form > div.el-form-item.captcha-form-item.is-required.el-form-item--small > div > div.el-input.el-input--small.el-input--prefix > input

5.验证码显示框
<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="el-image__inner">
#app > div > div.form-box > form > div.el-form-item.captcha-form-item.is-required.el-form-item--small > div > div.captcha-image > div > img

. 登录按钮
outerHTML：<button data-v-85a5cae8="" type="button" class="el-button btn-login el-button--primary el-button--medium"><!----><!----><span> 登录 </span></button>
Copy selector：#app > div > div.form-box > button

. 错误提示
outerHTML：<div class="el-form-item__error">
          请输入账号
        </div>
Copy selector：#app > div > div.form-box > form > div:nth-child(1) > div > div.el-form-item__error

页面是否存在 iframe：不确定

现有问题：登录时验证码随机，解决方案可以为每次验证码由人工手动输入，通过隐式等待让人工输入正确验证码后再往下继续执行测试
